- "pivotal commitment" — inflation word doing no work (B1/AI vocabulary).
- "seamless, vibrant collaboration" — two AI-vocabulary adjectives paired for texture, not meaning (B8).
- "empowering teams to unlock their full potential" — vague declarative with no fact behind it (B2); could be pasted into any product's marketing with no loss.
